notes: Startup repair for the v0.3.0 major audit. Replaces fragile PowerShell New-Object constructor syntax used by UI geometry and other .NET objects with explicit ::new(...) constructors so coordinate expressions such as y+5 are passed as two Point arguments instead of being misparsed as three. This fixes the startup crash reporting: Exception setting SelectedIndex: Cannot find an overload for Point and the argument count: 3. All v0.3.0 character-sheet audit features and separate user-data storage are preserved.
